description: Probe a URL for HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED terms using the x402 client SDK. Use before x402.pay_and_fetch to inspect price, network, and payTo without spending.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting. Omit for the anonymous free-tier id.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

headers.description: Optional extra request headers as a string map. Example: {"Accept": "application/json"}. Omit if none.
headers.title: Headers

method.description: HTTP method for the probe. Default GET. Example: 'GET' or 'POST'.
method.title: Method

url.description: Absolute HTTP URL to probe. Example: 'https://x402-mcp.onrender.com/us/mn/property-check?address=1700%20Penn%20Ave%20N'.
url.title: Url

name: x402.probe
title: Probe x402 payment requirements
